title: Senior Frontend Developer
profile:
Frontend developer with a strong focus on scalable applications, code quality, and user experience. I have several years of experience building modern React-based systems with TypeScript in agile teams.

I enjoy working on long-term solutions - from architecture and component structure to production-ready applications. My approach emphasizes structure, testability, and reusable components that make systems easier to evolve and maintain over time.

In addition to frontend development, I also explore full-stack development through personal projects and have a strong interest in the entire development lifecycle - from API design to deployment and infrastructure.

AI is an important tool, but it is not a universal solution. While it can speed up workflows and generate code quickly, developers still need to understand the code they write and ensure it maintains high quality, security, and long-term maintainability.
